title: VDBE finalized operation-array ownership transfer

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeTakeOpArray is the unique no-copy ownership boundary that finalizes labels/metadata and detaches the operation allocation from its builder Vdbe for subprogram ownership. Its preconditions, outputs and nulling mutation are atomic.

external_source_responsibilities: Caller assumes ownership and eventually invokes source-equivalent operation-array destruction
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete active transfer function, final fixup call, count/max-argument outputs, pointer identity and Vdbe ownership nulling are assigned. Destination SubProgram and P4 teardown remain follow-on units.

inputs: Vdbe with nonnull aOp, no sticky OOM, zero btreeMask
in/out maximum argument count and output operation count
outputs: same operation allocation pointer, exact nOp, updated max argument count, null Vdbe.aOp
contracts.ownership: Ownership moves without copying from Vdbe to caller. Labels are finalized/freed before transfer. Vdbe no longer frees the detached array.
contracts.state_and_results: nOp remains as historical metadata while aOp becomes null. Jump P2, reader/write flags and maximum virtual-table arguments are finalized first.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Source asserts away OOM and btree use; no fallible allocation occurs. Returned bytes remain valid until caller-owned P4-aware destruction.

representation_differences: C returns VdbeOp* and nulls the field; Zig returns [*]VdbeOp and performs the same nullable-field transition.

oracle.protocol: The shared builder creates Init, unresolved jump label and target, then both workers call TakeOpArray. The 366-observation trace compares returned pointer identity, detached aOp nulling, operation count, final P2, max arguments and label retirement.
oracle.normalization: Pointer address is normalized only to exact identity with the former owner. Counts, targets and null transitions are exact.

assurance.oom: No allocation; source rejects sticky OOM. Preceding builder/fixup OOM paths are covered by dependency traces.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback. Production mutex and subprogram lifetime remain integration obligations.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assertions constrain nonnull array, no OOM and zero btree mask.
assurance.continuation: Detached owner is retained through observation and explicitly freed between cases; builder does not double-free it.
assurance.performance: O(1) no-copy owner transfer after the dependency reverse fixup scan.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker executes append -> label resolve -> transfer on exact owners. Production subprogram compiler is not migrated.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. SubProgram/P4 teardown and compiler migration remain open.

independent_review.notes: Requires destination owner integration, assurance closure, and independent review.
